concept_decisions: Targeted original-scope correction of uniform mechanical paving. Preserve dense single-layer armor, narrow cracks, thin closed sandy substrate, original palette, illustrative dimensions and uncertainty. Replace grid sites with deterministic irregular non-grid multiscale sites (broad random sites plus clustered smaller chips), each clipped cell given angular edge chips, uneven low beveled rim and an asymmetric off-center faceted crown. Large and small clasts must interfit rather than be isolated pebbles. No camera, lighting or palette changes to conceal geometry. Close fitted lower footprints preserve surface armor; uneven crowns and size hierarchy break tile appearance. Nominal count around150 is illustrative. No exclusive wind-deflation origin claim.
intended_use: Educational support prop at256-512px, not museum/scientific-grade reconstruction

repair_of.finding: Uniform fitted cells read as decorative paving. Vary genuine clast size/shape/crown without opening large bare patches.
